correctness.rationale: The graph model is exact because every facet contains 2r vertices, so higher simplices cannot occur. The base Kneser graph is connected by a Johnson exchange path with a common disjoint neighbor. Every stacking removes exactly half C(2r,r) complementary edges and adds a connected Johnson-incidence gadget with C(2r,r-1) vertices and r*C(2r,r) edges. Old edge endpoints remain connected, so connectedness persists. Euler rank yields 1+(N-2r)(r-1)/2*C(2r+1,r). Independently enumerated finite cases corroborate all count and connectivity assertions.
